subject.title: Enhancement: Developer experience quick wins from code analysis

question: Which operator-visible surface should OpenClaw use for non-tool skill command prompt rewrites, and should the two remaining quick wins stay bundled in this issue or be split?
rationale: Source shows the prompt rewrite is real, but choosing between log, inline notice, trace/debug event, or status-only diagnostic affects operator UX and support behavior rather than being a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Split and choose diagnostic surface
options.body: Keep this issue as the umbrella or split focused follow-ups, then implement status registry diagnostics and a selected prompt-rewrite diagnostic with tests and docs.

options.title: Implement both under one issue
options.body: Treat the remaining work as one medium feature and implement status plus prompt-rewrite diagnostics together after choosing the warning surface.

options.title: Close prompt warning as not planned
options.body: Only track manifest-registry status diagnostics and explicitly decide that prompt rewrites should remain silent.

recommendation.title: Split and choose diagnostic surface
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the umbrella or split focused follow-ups, then implement status registry diagnostics and a selected prompt-rewrite diagnostic with tests and docs.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the skills CLI/skill command surfaces and already provided the prior keep-open review context.
